hyperedges.label: Conversation processing flow (page check, read, filter, Hermes, send, state)

nodes.label: HermesRunner
nodes.rationale: Isolate Hermes integration; spawn with separate args, timeout, output limit; never shell-concatenate user content.

nodes.label: Internal message data contract
nodes.rationale: IDs are opaque strings; fingerprint fallback; if duplicates cannot be distinguished safely, do not auto-reply.

nodes.label: Meta Business Suite inbox UI automation
nodes.norm_label: meta business suite inbox ui automation
nodes.rationale: No Graph API, Page token, webhook or cookie reading; everything via Chrome session OpenCLI controls.

nodes.label: Per-conversation leases
nodes.rationale: Recover from crashed workers and make overlapping runs safe.

nodes.label: Inbound message filter (after last Page message)
nodes.norm_label: inbound message filter (after last page message)

nodes.label: SQLite state store (state.db, no message text)
nodes.norm_label: sqlite state store (state.db, no message text)

nodes.label: Message state machine (received->queued->processing->sent)
nodes.rationale: send_unknown is never retried automatically to avoid duplicate replies.

nodes.label: scripts/watch.js scheduler loop
nodes.rationale: Exits with code 2 on logged out/checkpoint/CAPTCHA/wrong Page so an operator can log in again.

nodes.label: Technical spec: OpenCLI Messenger - Hermes Agent
nodes.norm_label: technical spec: opencli messenger - hermes agent

nodes.label: Echo/loop protection
nodes.rationale: Only trigger Hermes for clearly inbound messages; skip Page-sent messages.

nodes.label: No blind resend of uncertain sends
nodes.norm_label: no blind resend of uncertain sends
nodes.rationale: Check latest outbound in UI before resending to avoid duplicate replies.

nodes.label: Security and privacy (no cookies/tokens, sanitized logs)
nodes.norm_label: security and privacy (no cookies/tokens, sanitized logs)

nodes.label: Customer content treated as untrusted data
nodes.norm_label: customer content treated as untrusted data

nodes.label: Dry-run mode
nodes.rationale: Never sends or writes state, but still types and clears the reply box (customer may see typing indicator).

nodes.label: Hermes invocation (stdin prompt, --safe-mode)
nodes.rationale: Prompt on stdin, never argv; safe-mode disables user config, AGENTS.md, plugins and MCP servers.

nodes.label: MVP limits
nodes.rationale: Text-only, Messenger-only, 1:1, sequential in one tab; selectors depend on Business Suite internals (layout_changed errors).

nodes.label: Page check (data-surface business_scope)
nodes.rationale: Mismatch between selected and configured Page means nothing is read or sent.

nodes.label: Reading via React props (threadFBID, data-message-id)
nodes.rationale: React props are more stable than generated CSS classes.

nodes.label: Send with verification
nodes.rationale: Refuse if new messages arrived or a human draft exists; verify box; wait for rendered outbound message.

nodes.label: graphify usage rules (AGENTS.md)
nodes.rationale: Query graph before grep/read; dirty graphify-out files are expected and not a reason to skip graphify.

nodes.label: Run shell commands outside sandbox
nodes.rationale: Sandbox fails to initialize networking (bwrap loopback RTM_NEWADDR not permitted), so repository commands need elevated execution.

nodes.label: graphify usage rules (CLAUDE.md)
nodes.rationale: Scoped subgraph via query/path/explain is much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep; run graphify update after code changes; large graph.json diffs are expected.
